dedupe_keys.name: european regional covid 19 healthcare capacity and contextual indicators

description: This collection combines European regional COVID-19 counts with healthcare capacity, demographic, policy and environmental indicators. Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research and collaborating institutions compiled eighteen-country coverage, including countries outside the European Union. Pandemic measures cover March–August 2020, while contextual inputs use different earlier periods. The article describes mixed NUTS2 and NUTS3 spatial levels, including physician density and intensive-care capacity where available. Mendeley version 4 offers a workbook, GIS files and a nitrogen-dioxide raster free under CC BY 4.0. The metadata do not establish uniform completeness across countries, and the article is inconsistent about the regional level of hospital-bed fields. These limits preclude treating all variables as contemporaneous small-area observations. Modellers could construct healthcare-demand scenarios and compare regional surge assumptions. model-simpy-streamlit-healthcare-des is a related service-capacity model requiring more detailed operational inputs. No geospatial or health-data files were downloaded, and no epidemiological relationship was estimated.
